answer_first.summary: Bennett weakness maps to the constraint-selection side of Pact, not to deletion of the counted archive-rate term.

canonical_equation_registration.reason: Seed 2 is already embodied by existing closed-scorer, quotient, tolerance-capped, score-quotient, and direct-description equations/specs.

paper_formalism.implementable_language: Finite vocabulary v induces implementable language L_v.
paper_formalism.extension: Z_l is the extension of statement l; larger |Z_l| means weaker hypothesis.
paper_formalism.task: alpha = (S_alpha, D_alpha, M_alpha), with situations, correct decisions, and models consistent with the child task.
paper_formalism.induction: Choose a child-task model by maximizing proxy q_v; generalization succeeds when it is also a parent-task model.
paper_formalism.main_theorem_boundary: Under the paper's uniform task distribution over a fixed implementable vocabulary, weakness is necessary and sufficient for optimal generalization probability; MDL is neither necessary nor sufficient in that formal setting.
paper_formalism.pact_boundary: Pact is a fixed single-video contest with external archive-byte accounting, so weakness is a constraint lens only.

seed_verdicts.name: Weakness over shortest description
seed_verdicts.result: Quotient, blind, and tolerance surfaces already drop scorer-invisible or task-irrelevant specification.
seed_verdicts.falsifier_or_boundary: Byte-closed same-object row where preserving a more specific scorer-invisible description improves exact S at equal counted bytes; ker(A) byte-credit without receiver parse-back remains invalid.

seed_verdicts.name: Weakest-then-shortest equation
seed_verdicts.result: The direct-description and closed-scorer equations already encode weakest sufficient scorer constraints followed by shortest counted archive under feasibility.
seed_verdicts.falsifier_or_boundary: A live objective that minimizes counted bytes before quotient/scorer constraints and demonstrably over-constrains the witness.

seed_verdicts.name: Amortized held-out targeter lens
seed_verdicts.result: Use weakness only as a paired fixed-byte targeter-selection discriminator; ST2 is supportive but confounded.
seed_verdicts.falsifier_or_boundary: Same bytes, same receiver, same coder, fixed heldout cells: the weaker targeter loses recall and score-effect to a more specific targeter.

seed_verdicts.name: Non-applicability guard
seed_verdicts.result: The paper cannot be used to argue away Pact's externally charged rate term.
seed_verdicts.falsifier_or_boundary: Boundary guard; a citation saying weakness makes bytes irrelevant is out of scope.

seed_verdicts.name: Epistemic weakest claim
seed_verdicts.result: The verdict-scope ladder already enforces the weakest claim justified by evidence.
seed_verdicts.falsifier_or_boundary: Any scope escalation without proof across the ladder is a citation bug.
